purpose: Bounded software diagnosis of 4BVN missing-loop preparation rejected for inverted ILE241 CA. At most four deterministic native PDBFixer attempts on the six already identified missing residues; no production MD, new predictions, source mutation, or native loop-pose accuracy claim. Existing chirality, backbone continuity, observed-coordinate and force-field quality gates remain mandatory.
review_identity: Language-model evidence synthesis and automated PatAgent checklist; not professional certification or Pat Walters endorsement.

reproducibility.budget: At most four PDBFixer loop build attempts total, four CPU threads, five minutes total. No production MD trajectory. PDBFixer addMissingAtoms may internally perform initial minimization and up to ten 200-step, 5-fs Langevin clash-relief segments followed by minimization; this local construction relaxation is within the preparation probe budget. Explicit seeds and settings recorded per attempt; original source and failed job remain unchanged.

data.policy: Official deposited coordinate/sequence/assembly records are preserved. Derivatives retain exact observed heavy coordinates and document chain, assembly, solvent/additive removal and terminal omissions. GROMACS uses complete unprepared standard protein inputs; no missing internal residues or ligand deletion to force compatibility. OpenMM retains primary ligands and validated ions. Modeled protein/ligand atoms require explicit recorded choice and uncertainty. GPCR uses the complete observed transmembrane construct rather than an unlabeled soluble fragment. Channel requires tetramer assembly and explicit nonoverlapping ion-occupancy interpretation; symmetry-axis ions cannot be multiplied silently.

output_checks: Strict original signed-volume guard at all standard/modified centers; reject planar/inverted centers
Observed atom identity and coordinates unchanged; only originally missing positions may be rebuilt
Finite coordinates, bonded backbone lengths and no structural gaps
Attempts and any selection rule recorded; first valid attempt, not claim of best native loop
Complete actual prep still required before MD; no guard bypass
validation.scope: Only bounded preparation diagnostics cleared; no final output is yet validated.
validation.review_of_installed_pdbfixer: 1.12 addMissingAtoms random seed is used by optional clash-relief Langevin relaxation, not initial deterministic minimization; observed atoms are massless and only new-atom minimized positions copied back. Changing seeds may reproduce identical failures when optional relaxation is not entered.

comparison.notes: No engine ranking or physical equivalence claim; OpenMM and GROMACS presets use different force fields. No holdout scientific dataset or uncertainty estimate is asserted.
comparison.claim_limit: No scientific accuracy estimates, native loop inference or sampling uncertainty is available. Software controls pass; loop conformation remains uncertain.
